profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at TapTap Send
profile.summary: Versatile Software Engineer with 12 years of experience solving diverse problems across multiple industries.  Currently building solutions with kotlin, spring, kafka, and more.  Passionate about consistency, reliability, and getting data where it’s needed most.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Python · Kotlin · PostgreSQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · TypeScript · React.js

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built the central cash management engine from the ground up for banking and exchange products, supporting customer accounts and fiat transfers through global financial-partner integrations.
• Led a staged migration of customer banking to asynchronous Kafka-based workflows, breaking long-running operations into recoverable steps that enabled automated issue resolution and improved customer experience.
• Architected event-driven processors that routed customer banking requests through appropriate workflows, enforced state transitions, supported idempotent retries, and reported failures for investigation.
• Aligned engineering and compliance stakeholders on institution-specific requirements, establishing a repeatable process to evolve identity models and onboard new financial institutions to support business growth.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Applied domain-driven design and error classification to automate error recovery, reducing loans needing morning manual intervention by roughly 75%.
• Improved processing throughput from hundreds to thousands of loans per day by utilizing distributed messaging, batch processing, and concurrency.
• Implemented a crypto-backed lending product including collateral monitoring, margin calls, and liquidation.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Developed .NET solutions for billing, payroll tax calculation, and contact center workforce managment
• Introduced modifications to our AGILE process lowering story cycle time by 25%.
• Modernized team CI/CD with TeamCity pipelines that ran tests, built deployable artifacts, and automated releases, ending coordinated after-hours manual server updates.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: • Built an automated testing framework and web application to replicate customized environments, run scheduled and on-demand tests, and report on testing results

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Owned delivery of C# monitoring and maintenance applications from user interviews through development, testing, and post-release support.
• Implemented jet engine control logic and communication modules in C.
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · Python · Communication · SQL · JavaScript · C#

positions.title: Research Assistant - Multimedia Lab
positions.description:
• Designed and developed algorithms and statistical models with R to analyze research data.
• Developed and maintained JavaScript, HTML, and CSS for WebRTC based research website.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant - Communication Systems
positions.description: • Provided supplemental instruction for students enrolled in Communication Systems (EEL 4512)

publications.title: Parameterized Framework for the Analysis of Visual Quality Assessments Using Crowdsourcing
